A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the results of the present study indicate the importance of the interaction of retinoids with cyclic adenosine monphosphate (cAMP) signaling pathways in normal and neoplastically transformed lung cells.
retinoids have the ability to modulate the mitogenic signaling pathways of normal and neoplasma cells, but the effects are cell type specific.
